news.title: Sabar Flex India Limited (NSEI:SABAR) acquired Pionex Agricom Private Limited.
news.body:
Sabar Flex India Limited (NSEI:SABAR) acquired Pionex Agricom Private Limited on March 26, 2026. A cash consideration will be paid by Sabar Flex India Limited.

For the period ending March 31, 2025, Pionex Agricom Private Limited reported total revenue of INR 488.47 million.

Sabar Flex India Limited (NSEI:SABAR) completed the acquisition of Pionex Agricom Private Limited on March 26, 2026.

news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 0.5% Last year net profit margin: 3.4% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. news.title: New major risk - Financial data availability
news.body: The company's latest financial reports are more than a year old. Last reported fiscal period ended September 2024. This is considered a major risk. If the company has not reported its earnings on time, it may have been delayed due to audit problems or it may be finding it difficult to reconcile its accounts. In the worst case scenario, it may be facing other major going concern issues jeopardizing its viability as a listed company. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Latest financial reports are more than 1 year old (reported September 2024 fiscal period end).
